milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the red wool house and face it. The target is the center of the front wall of the house at spawn-relative (10, 2, 6). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='torch') because this is a place/build task. The player must place at least 1 torch inside the house interior. The box covers the interior space (spawn-relative 7,0,7 to 13,5,13) with slight vertical buffer to catch wall-mounted torches. Checking for min_count=1 torch block confirms the house has been lit up.
